programs.title: Bring A Plate
programs.desc: Nimi serves up her favourite vegetarian Punjabi dish, Poori-Chole. Even though some guests can't eat spicy food, Nimi shares how to enjoy the dish using yoghurt and pickles so everyone can enjoy it.

programs.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programs.desc: Adam samples the famous Eton Mess in Eton. He also enjoys afternoon tea fit for a Royal in Windsor, samples venison in bon-bon bar snacks and makes some tasty fudge.

programs.title: Kriol Kitchen
programs.sub_title: Bo Carne: Nana's Half Caste Stew & Magpie Goose Giblet & Heart Blachan
programs.desc: Everyone has a stew they can brag about. In this episode, Bo Carne shares his Nana's version of the good old billabong stew.

programs.title: Marcus Wareing's Kitchen Garden Tales
programs.desc: As autumn has drawn in, it's time to take stock of the kitchen garden and preserve any remaining summer crops so that they last through the winter and don't go to waste.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Matt gets a recipe from his Nan and cooks it up. Mike makes some nostalgic Jamaican beef patties. Chef Adam D'Sylva and dessert Chef Kay-Lene Tan go head-to-head.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Harvest time starts in late August in Italy, and it is one of the most important celebrations in the culture! Lidia celebrates with her oat risotto, makes olive-oil cake and red wine poached pears.
